Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI/UX Designer at DooDigital.co and was drawn to your focus on conversion-focused digital experiences and eCommerce web design.

In my recent agency work at Ascent Business Solutions, I designed over 100 digital and print creatives and built reusable systems that cut turnaround time, while my earlier role at AT Creation involved usability testing and developer handoff.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates structured thinking and an end-to-end UX process for web-based applications, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am based in Nagpur, ready to relocate to Thane or Mumbai, and would welcome a brief look at my Bounceless case study.

Ananya

During my time at AT Creation as a UI/UX designer, I conducted usability testing and translated those insights into improved user flows, wireframes, and prototypes for early-stage products. I also bring hands-on experience with Figma, wireframing, and structured visual systems from my current work at Ascent Business Solutions.

You can see how I approach structured problem-solving for digital tools in my Bounceless case study at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/, which demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for B2B users.
